title: Future of the Commission on Children and Youth
summary: On October 20, 2026, a Maui High School student asked the committee to make the Commission on Children and Youth youth-led, citing 56 signatures and 12 testimonies in support. The chair told Member Johnson, "I look forward to supporting your bill" to fill the council with youth. Earlier, a bill to repeal the commission was deferred in December 2025 after its sponsor said it no longer does its original job.
